0022600142.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (4-0, 1st in the Northwest and 1st in the West) visit the Dallas Mavericks (2-2, 8th in the West and 4th in the Southwest, 2 games back) in the Thunder's fifth game of the season. Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), Otega Oweh (Achilles, surgery) and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Naji Marshall (illness), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 100-87 win in Dallas on March 1, 2026.
